description_en: Asynchronously generates the JSON configuration for updating a synchronization task
description_zh: 异步生成更新同步任务的JSON
name: GenerateDISyncTaskConfigForUpdating

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

This parameter determines the DataWorks workspace in which the API operation is called
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Data Integration synchronization task to be updated asynchronously. Valid values:
DI_REALTIME: real-time synchronization task.
DI_SOLUTION: solution synchronization task.
Only real-time and solution synchronization tasks can be updated asynchronously
parameters.help_zh:
使用异步方式更新数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：
DI_REALTIME：表示实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示解决方案同步任务。
仅支持使用异步方式更新数据集成实时同步任务和解决方案同步任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The script statements for updating the synchronization task.
Currently, the asynchronous method only supports adding or removing tables for data integration synchronization tasks. Only the following types of synchronization tasks can be updated:
Synchronizing MySQL data to MaxCompute.
Synchronizing MySQL data to Kafka.
Synchronizing MySQL data to Hologres.

In a synchronization task, SelectedTables is used to select tables in multi-database mode, and Tables is used to select tables in single-database mode.
If the script contains the SelectedTables statement, the system uses the table information in the SelectedTables statement for synchronization.
If the script contains the Tables statement, the system uses the field information in the Tables statement for synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
更新同步任务的脚本语句。
目前仅支持通过异步方式为数据集成同步任务新增表或者删除表，并且仅支持更新如下类型的同步任务：
同步MySQL数据至MaxCompute。
同步MySQL数据至Kafka。
同步MySQL数据至Hologres。

同步任务中的SelectedTables用于多库模式选择同步表，Tables用于单库模式选择同步表。
当脚本中包含SelectedTables语句时，系统会使用SelectedTables语句中的表信息进行同步。
当脚本中包含Tables语句时，系统会使用Tables的字段信息进行同步
parameters.name: task_param

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure idempotence. This parameter prevents duplicate operations caused by multiple calls
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数。用于避免多次调用导致操作重复
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, TaskId is the FileId of the real-time synchronization task.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, TaskId is the FileId of the solution synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
当TaskType参数配置为实时同步任务（DI_REALTIME），则TaskId为实时同步任务的FileId。
当TaskType参数配置为解决方案同步任务（DI_SOLUTION），则TaskId为解决方案同步任务的FileId
parameters.name: task_id

Data.description_en: The result of generating the asynchronous thread ID

Message.description_en: The reason why the asynchronous thread ID failed to be generated. If the asynchronous thread ID is generated, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh: 异步线程ID生成失败的原因描述。 如果成功生成异步线程ID，则该参数的返回值为空

ProcessId.description_en: The asynchronous thread ID. You must use this ID to call the [QueryDISyncTaskConfigProcessResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383465.html） operation to obtain the parameters required for asynchronously updating the data integration synchronization task, and then use the parameters to update the task
ProcessId.description_zh: 异步线程ID。您需要通过该ID，调用[QueryDISyncTaskConfigProcessResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383465.html）接口获取异步生成更新数据集成同步任务需要的参数，后续使用该参数更新数据集成同步任务

Status.description_en:
The status of generating the asynchronous thread ID. Valid values:
success: The asynchronous thread ID was generated.
fail: The asynchronous thread ID failed to be generated. You can view the cause of the failure and resolve the issue
Status.description_zh:
生成异步线程ID的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示成功生成异步线程ID。
fail：表示异步线程ID生成失败。您可以查看失败原因，处理相关问题

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
